reasoning_content: The connection has been restored. I'll obtain the final state.

action.command:
echo "===== FINAL STATE $(date +%H:%M) ====="
echo "--- containers ---"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}' | sort
echo "--- frontends via proxy (port 80) ---"
for h in app.workspace.localhost cms.workspace.localhost boards.workspace.localhost; do
  code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null --max-time 10 -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:80/" -H "Host: $h" 2>/dev/null)
  echo "  $h -> $code"
done
echo "--- direct ports ---"
for p in 39001 39002 39003; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
echo "--- backend + keycloak ---"
docker logs urbo-workspace-spring-app-1 2>&1 | grep -c "Started UrboCmsApplicationKt"
curl -sS --max-time 15 "http://127.0.0.1:80/realms/swcode/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: keycloak.workspace.localhost" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=urbo-frontend&username=test@test.de&password=test" | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log("  admin login: token="+!!j.access_token+" type="+j.token_type)}catch(e){console.log("  login err: "+d.slice(0,60))}})'
free -m | sed -n '2p'
